title: Neocloud Lambda secures $1B in debt to buy more chips | TechCrunch
summary: Lambda, an AI cloud company that buys computing chips and rents them out to businesses, has raised $1 billion in private, short-dated debt to buy Nvidia’s AI chips that it will lease to Microsoft, Bloomberg reports .
